source: Loreforge Mythos (original stats for creatures from H. P. Lovecraft’s public-domain stories)

monsters.name: Deep One
monsters.langs: Common, the croaking tongue of the deep

traits.d: It can breathe air and water.
It does not die of old age; the oldest grow huge and dwell in drowned cities.

actions.d: It makes two attacks: one with its claws and one with its trident.
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

monsters.lore: Fish-eyed, grey-green and scaled, they rise from the sea to trade with and breed among coastal folk who worship them.

monsters.name: Hybrid of the Deep

traits.d: It has advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks against those who know what it is becoming.

actions.d: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

monsters.lore: Townsfolk with heavy-lidded, unblinking eyes and creased necks, slowly changing toward the sea.

monsters.name: Burrow Ghoul

traits.d: It can smell dead flesh within 1 mile.
It has resistance to bludgeoning damage from nonmagical attacks.

actions.d: It makes two claw attacks and one bite.
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

monsters.lore: Hound-faced, stooping things with mouldy hides that tunnel beneath old cemeteries and feast on the dead.

monsters.name: Night-Gaunt

traits.d: It makes no sound and has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
It does not provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of reach.

actions.d: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be incapacitated until the end of its next turn, helpless with laughter and dread.
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). It can fly while carrying the target.

monsters.lore: Faceless, horned and rubbery-winged, they snatch travellers in the dark and carry them off without a sound.

monsters.name: Fungus from Yuggoth

traits.d: It has resistance to cold damage and needs no air.
Given an hour and its tools, it can place a living brain in a metal cylinder that keeps it alive and aware.

actions.d: It makes two pincer attacks.
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13).
Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) cold damage.

monsters.lore: Pinkish, crab-clawed fungal beings that cross the void on membranous wings and mine the hills in secret.

monsters.name: The Colour Out of Space

traits.d: It can move through creatures and objects as difficult terrain, and has resistance to all damage except force and radiant.
Plants and animals within 120 ft. slowly grey and crumble while it remains; creatures within 30 ft. at the start of their turn take 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.d: Melee Spell Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) necrotic damage, and the target’s maximum hit points drop by the same amount until it finishes a long rest.

monsters.lore: A hue no eye has a name for, fallen from the sky into a farm well, that drains the life from everything around it.

monsters.name: Gug

traits.d: It deals double damage to objects and structures.
It has disadvantage on attacks and Perception checks in sunlight.

actions.d: It makes two forearm slams and one bite.
Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage.

monsters.lore: Twenty-foot giants with four-forked arms and mouths that split their heads from crown to chin, exiled to an underworld of tombs.

monsters.name: Ghast

traits.d: It takes 10 radiant damage at the start of each turn it spends in sunlight.
Its long jump is up to 30 ft. with or without a running start.

actions.d: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.lore: Kangaroo-legged, noseless things of the deep vaults that hunt by smell and die in daylight.

monsters.name: Moon-Beast

traits.d: It has advantage on checks to bind, herd or command captives.

actions.d: It makes two tentacle attacks.
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 14).
Its almost-human slaves fight for it; it rarely bloodies its own tentacles.

monsters.lore: Pale, toad-like masses with a cluster of pink tentacles where a face should be, sailing black galleys between dreams.

monsters.name: Hound of the Angles

traits.d: As a bonus action it can step out of any corner (an angle of 120° or less) it can see within 120 ft. Round rooms keep it out.
Once it has a creature’s scent through time, it always knows where that creature is.

actions.d: It makes two claw attacks and one tongue attack.
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and the target’s Constitution score drops by 1 until it finishes a long rest.

monsters.lore: Lean, thirsting things from the angled depths of time that track anyone who glimpses them across the ages.

monsters.name: Elder Thing

traits.d: It can lie dormant for eons and wake fully aware.
It cannot be flanked and has advantage on saving throws against being knocked prone.

actions.d: It makes two tentacle attacks.
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Each creature within 60 ft. that can hear it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

monsters.lore: Barrel-shaped, star-headed builders of a frozen city older than mankind, wise and utterly alien.

monsters.name: Shoggoth

traits.d: It can squeeze through any space at least 6 inches wide.
It regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn unless it took fire damage since its last turn.
A creature that sees this thing for the first time in a day must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of it until the end of its next turn.
Its piping cry can be heard for a mile; creatures hearing it have disadvantage on Wisdom saves against its Dreadful Sight.

actions.d: It makes three pseudopod attacks.
Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 18).
It moves over a creature it is grappling; the creature is swallowed, restrained, and takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

monsters.lore: A heaving, bubbling mass of black protoplasm and countless eyes, bred long ago as a slave and never truly tamed.

monsters.name: Star-Spawn of the Sleeper

traits.d: A creature that sees this thing for the first time in a day must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of it until the end of its next turn.
Sensitive sleepers within 100 miles share its dreams; it can send a dream message to one of them each night.
If it fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.d: It makes one claw attack and two face-tentacle attacks.
Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) slashing damage.
Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 22).

legendary.d: One creature it can see must succeed on a DC 20 Intelligence save or take 27 (6d8) psychic damage.

monsters.lore: A towering, winged and octopoid-headed mountain of flesh that sleeps beneath the sea and dreams the world into madness.

monsters.name: Mythos Cultist
monsters.langs: Common, a little of the old tongue

traits.d: It has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

actions.d: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

monsters.lore: Ordinary-seeming folk who gather by night at standing stones and swamp altars to chant to things beyond the stars.

monsters.name: High Priest of the Deep
monsters.langs: Common, the croaking tongue of the deep

traits.d: Allied deep ones within 30 ft. have advantage on attack rolls while the priest can chant.

actions.d: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.
Water surges in a 30-ft. line: DC 13 Strength save or take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

monsters.lore: Golden-tiaraed leaders of seaside congregations, more fish than man beneath their robes.
